title: Add audio ASR pipeline

context.summary: Route audio transcription through @mindory/llm ASR and persist searchable time-coded transcript artifacts.
context.background: The audio extractor currently uses embedded WAV INFO/ICMT transcript text or filename fallback. TASK-78 makes configured local HTTP ASR calls real through the central LLM SDK while keeping RAW audio immutable.

in: Expose a local-http ASR provider from @mindory/llm.
Wire ASR provider and role descriptors into the audio transcript extractor.
Persist ASR transcript segments as derived transcript artifacts and text spans with time refs.
Keep embedded transcript and filename fallback behavior when ASR is disabled.
Add integration coverage with a fake local ASR provider.
Update docs and validators for audio ASR support.
out: Cloud-specific ASR adapters beyond the local HTTP contract.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/llm exposes a local-http ASR provider when ASR is enabled.
Audio extraction calls @mindory/llm ASR when ASR is enabled.
ASR calls POST /asr through @mindory/llm and records operation audit.
ASR transcript segments are searchable through artifact/document search with time source refs.
Disabled ASR remains non-blocking and embedded transcript fallback still works.

manual_checks: Confirm RAW audio objects remain immutable and ASR output is derived state.

risks: ASR model calls must remain inside @mindory/llm.
Required ASR failures must fail extraction clearly.
Experimental ASR remains gated by MINDORY_INSTALL_ALLOW_EXPERIMENTAL.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
